name: Bangladesh
warningSystem: Cyclone signals are numbered 1–10. Signal 8 or higher means DANGER: evacuate coastal areas. Cyclone Preparedness Programme (CPP) volunteers announce warnings with megaphones and flags. Call 1090 (free) for the latest weather and disaster warnings.

agencies.name: Department of Disaster Management
agencies.description: National government agency for disaster response, relief distribution and shelters. Your Upazila and Union Parishad offices coordinate local relief.

agencies.name: Cyclone Preparedness Programme
agencies.description: Joint programme of the government and Bangladesh Red Crescent. Volunteers spread warnings and help coastal families evacuate to cyclone shelters.

agencies.name: Bangladesh Meteorological Department
agencies.description: Issues official cyclone signals, heavy-rain and weather warnings.

agencies.name: Flood Forecasting and Warning Centre
agencies.description: River flood forecasts and warnings for all major rivers.

agencies.name: Bangladesh Red Crescent Society
agencies.description: Emergency first aid, evacuation support, relief items, cash assistance and family tracing.

agencies.name: Fire Service and Civil Defence
agencies.description: Search and rescue, fire and building collapse response. Reach through 999.

programs.name: Gratuitous Relief (GR) food and cash
programs.description: Emergency rice, dry food and cash for households affected by a disaster.
programs.howToApply: Register with your Union Parishad chairman or ward member after the disaster. Bring your national ID card if you have it.

programs.name: House repair grant (Corrugated iron sheets + cash)
programs.description: Tin sheets and cash for families whose homes were damaged or destroyed.
programs.howToApply: Report damage to your Union Parishad. Officials assess damage and add you to the beneficiary list.

programs.name: Red Crescent emergency cash
programs.description: Multi-purpose cash grants, often prioritising households with young children, elderly people, pregnant women or people with disabilities.
programs.howToApply: Volunteers register families in affected areas. Contact your nearest BDRCS unit.

programs.name: Livestock and fodder support
programs.description: Emergency fodder, vaccination and veterinary care for animals in flood and cyclone areas.

shelters.name: Cox's Bazar Sadar Multipurpose Cyclone Shelter (sample)
